_provenance: Schema-derived fixture — Cycle B2 RED. Defines the required OUTPUT SHAPE of advisors.lens_technicals._fetch_technicals(universe). Written before any implementation (TDD RED phase). Values marked __is_*__ are type/format assertions — NOT hardcoded producer outputs (feedback_no_hardcoded_test_values). Alpaca bar input shape is separately pinned at tests/fixtures/math/alpaca_bars_schema.json.
_indicator_reference: SMA windows (50-day, 200-day) are industry-standard technical analysis parameters documented in Murphy, J.J. 'Technical Analysis of the Financial Markets' (1999), ch. 9. Momentum window (20-day ≈ 1 trading month) is a standard short-term momentum lookback. All window sizes must appear as named constants in the producer code (project coding standard — no magic numbers).
_normalization_note: breadth is pct_above_50sma expressed as a fraction in [0.0, 1.0]. ma_posture.pct_above_50sma and ma_posture.pct_above_200sma are also fractions in [0.0, 1.0] (0.0 = none above, 1.0 = all above). momentum.mean_20d_return is a decimal return (e.g. 0.03 = +3%). Tests derive expected values from fixture bar data — never hardcode them.

invariants.breadth_bounds: when available=True and breadth is not None: 0.0 <= breadth <= 1.0
invariants.pct_above_50sma_bounds: when ma_posture is not None and pct_above_50sma is not None: 0.0 <= pct_above_50sma <= 1.0
invariants.pct_above_200sma_bounds: when ma_posture is not None and pct_above_200sma is not None: 0.0 <= pct_above_200sma <= 1.0
invariants.reason_d1_compliant: reason is type(exc).__name__ only — never str(exc)
invariants.no_fabricated_values: when Alpaca fetch fails or returns empty bars: available=False — never fabricate indicator values
invariants.partial_availability: when insufficient bars for 200-day SMA only: pct_above_200sma=None, pct_above_50sma may still be a valid float

expected_source_provenance: Alpaca Markets v2 daily bars via synthetic_history.fetch_bars
